ideas.description: Base: E070 code (e945ed5; 2@16 + 1.25@24 + 4@32 px, 7.25 ep, head Muon lr 0.5x, Muon floor 0.05, static shapes, max(dim).values pool). Precondition, untimed (H4.2.4): diff e945ed5 against 766d5bf (E068) and a1aef09 (E064) and log whether E070 already has the Fable tail. If it has the tail, do not run this; mark H2.10.4 refuted and go straight to the 32 px trim idea. If it lacks the tail, port the E068 tail unchanged, with all step counts rescaled to E070's total: LR decay reaches its floor at ~96% of steps and holds there; lookahead stops for the last ~8 steps; a final EMA lerp 0.3 runs every 4 steps (foreach_lerp, buffers allocated in build and reset in prepare); eval uses the EMA weights with BN buffers from the net. Change nothing else. Score it twice and log the source hash. Instrumentation: an untimed off-seed run of seeds 3-10 through the benchmark trial code, which also covers the H4.2.5 margin check.
ideas.expected: Time 4.57-4.62 s, equal to E070/E071 (4.583 s) within 0.8%. Two-run pooled accuracy 0.7550-0.7565, about +0.15 to +0.25 pp over the E070/E071 pool of 0.7537, and an off-seed mean of at least 0.7535. If the pool is 0.7550 or higher, this is the new tip at ~4.58 s with ~0.2 pp of margin to spend on the 32 px trim. If the pool is 0.7540 or lower, the tail and the reshuffle do not stack.

ideas.description: Gated on the tail-on-E070 idea reaching a pool of at least 0.7550. On that verified tail tip, cut the 32 px phase by 0.25 epoch: 2@16 + 1.25@24 + 3.75@32 px (7.0 ep), with a step-indexed switch. Rescale LR warmup/decay, the floor-hold point, the final-EMA window, lookahead and the renorm cadence to the new total step count, the same way E070 did. All shapes are already warmed up. Change nothing else. Score it twice, plus an untimed off-seed run of seeds 3-10. If the gate pool is only 0.7545-0.7550, cut 0.125 epoch instead (3.875@32).
ideas.expected: Time about 4.36-4.40 s (-4 to -5%, since a 32 px epoch at bs 1536 is ~0.87 s). Accuracy -0.10 to -0.20 pp (Muon full-res slope ~0.54 pp/epoch), giving a two-run pool of ~0.7538-0.7550. If the pool is 0.7540 or higher with the off-seed mean at 0.7530 or higher, this is the new tip. A loss of 0.3 pp or more means the 32 px tail is binding, and further cuts must come from elsewhere.

ideas.description: Math-neutral. On the current tip code (the tail variant if banked, otherwise E070), add a full synthetic dress-rehearsal trial to build. Run prepare + the complete train loop on random uint8 data of the real shape: every phase, the resolution switches, the renorm on/off variants, the tail's floor-hold, the lookahead stop, the final-EMA foreach_lerp, the BN buffer copy, and eval at B=1024 and B=1. Then discard all state; prepare still resets everything. This warms the allocator pool, cuBLAS workspaces, cuDNN plans and any lazily compiled tail or EMA kernels that may currently first run inside timed trial 1. Log per-trial prepare/train times. Build stays well under 600 s (one synthetic trial is ~5 s). Score once.
ideas.expected: Accuracy unchanged within noise (same math). Prediction: today trial 1 runs ≥0.5% slower than trials 2-3 (E069: 4.757 vs 4.708). The rehearsal removes that gap, so mean time drops 0.3-0.8% (~0.015-0.035 s). If trial 1 already matched trials 2-3 before the change and the mean time moves by less than 0.3%, H2.14.3 is refuted and lazy-init levers are closed.

ideas.description: On the verified tail tip, change only the head's Muon lr multiplier from 0.5x to 0.4x of the filter lr. This is close to the spectral-condition value sqrt(100/576) ≈ 0.42. Set it through the head's own 0-d tensor so nothing recompiles. Decide with an untimed off-seed A/B on seeds 3-10 (tip vs 0.4x) plus two scored runs.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.5%). Accuracy -0.1 to +0.15 pp vs the tip: the scored pool and the off-seed paired difference should both be at least +0.05 pp. A gain of +0.1 pp or more on both is margin for the 32 px trim. If 0.4x is 0.1 pp or more worse, the head optimum is at or above 0.5x and head lr is closed.

ideas.description: Explore. On the verified tail tip, replace label smoothing 0.3 with MaxSup: loss = CE(z, y) + 0.3*(max_k z_k - mean_k z_k), one fused op on the fp32-cast [B,100] logits inside the compiled train graph. Before scoring, smoke-test 10 steps for a finite loss under compile at every resolution. Change nothing else. Decide with an untimed off-seed run on seeds 3-10 plus two scored runs.
ideas.expected: Time within ±0.5%. Accuracy -0.3 to +0.3 pp. If both the off-seed mean and the scored pool beat the tip by 0.15 pp or more, MaxSup is a zero-cost margin source to spend on a trim. A difference within ±0.1 pp closes it. A loss of 0.2 pp or more means the 8-epoch regime needs LS's target-side regularization.

ideas.description: Tail ablation on the verified tail tip, arm (a) only: remove the final EMA, so eval uses the net weights. Keep the floor-hold and the lookahead stop exactly as they are. Change nothing else. Run one scored run plus an untimed off-seed run of seeds 3-10, compared against the tip's off-seed mean. Arm (b), removing only the floor-hold, is queued only if arm (a) costs less than 0.05 pp.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.5%). If the final EMA carries the gain, accuracy falls 0.1-0.2 pp on both scored and off-seed, and EMA length and decay become the next tuning axis. If accuracy falls by 0.05 pp or less, the floor-hold or lookahead stop carries the gain, so the floor level should be tuned next. Info-only: no time gain expected.

drop.reason: The base is stale: it runs on E062 code, while the tip is now E070, possibly plus the tail. The prior is low (Muon lr was flat at 0.20-0.24 in E034, H7.1.3 confidence 0.10), and two scored runs on an obsolete base cannot be pooled against the current tip. Zero-cost levers should be decided on the tail tip with an off-seed A/B; higher-value candidates (head lr 0.4x, MaxSup, tail ablation) are queued for that.

structured_output.summary:
I added six ideas, dropped one and kept I081, which leaves 7 queued plus I079 running.

The top priority is to settle whether E070 has the Fable tail. Its description says the base is E064 code (a1aef09), and that base had no tail. If the tail is missing, adding it to E070's schedule (2@16 + 1.25@24 + 4@32, 7.25 epochs) should give about +0.15 to +0.25 pp at about 4.58 s (H2.10.4). The same idea runs an off-seed check on seeds 3-10, which covers the H4.2.5 margin check. That margin pays for the next exploit: the first-ever fractional trim of the 32 px phase, 3.75@32, expected around 4.37-4.40 s (H2.10.5). This is the largest remaining schedule saving, because the 32 px phase is about 71% of the time. A math-neutral idea warms the full trial path in build, including the tail's final-EMA and lerp kernels, which are probably new since E068. The aim is to remove the trial-1 slowdown seen in E069 (H2.14.3, -0.3 to -0.8%).

The explore and accuracy ideas are decided with off-seed A/Bs plus two scored runs:
- head Muon lr at 0.4x, the spectral-condition value (H7.3.4);
- MaxSup in place of label smoothing (H6.6.1);
- removing only the final EMA from the tail, to find which part carries its gain (H6.5.3).

I dropped I080 (filter Muon lr 0.28) because its base is stale and its prior is low.
